In the 2024–25 Playoffs, he guided New York to its first Eastern Conference Finals appearance in 25 years, highlighted by a stunning upset of the defending champion Boston Celtics in the semifinals. Joining Luka Dončić as a rookie on the Dallas Mavericks, Brunson quickly carved out a role with his scoring and poise. His breakout came in Game 2 of the 2022 Western Conference First Round, when he dropped 41 points, 8 rebounds, 5 assists, and 2 steals to lead Dallas past Utah without Dončić. That postseason run culminated in a trip to the Western Conference Finals, the team’s best finish since 2011. In the summer of 2022, Brunson signed with the New York Knicks and immediately elevated the franchise as its floor general. He delivered career-best numbers in points and assists, sparked the Knicks’ first playoff series win in a decade, and has since lifted New York into contender status. Over his three seasons in New York, the Knicks have increased their win total each year under his leadership. At the time of cataloging, Brunson holds career averages of 19.2 points, 3.2 rebounds, and 5.3 assists per game. He is a two-time NBA All-Star, a two-time All-NBA Second Team selection, and the 2024–25 NBA Clutch Player of the Year. This jersey has been photomatched by Sotheby’s Photomatching.

The NBA’s all-time leading scorer, LeBron James is recognized as one of the greatest players in the history of professional basketball. Debuting with the Cleveland Cavaliers, he was the first overall pick of the 2003 NBA draft. After winning two NBA championships in 2012 and 2013 for the Miami Heat, James returned to Cleveland. In 2016 he led the Cavaliers to their first NBA Championship, ending the city’s 52-year-long professional sports title drought. After his 2020 Championship with the Los Angeles Lakers, he became the only player to win the NBA Finals MVP with three different teams.
